title: Concept: Content security policy default source is a wildcard
description: A default-src directive that names a wildcard source in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: Every fetch type without its own directive inherits the wildcard, so fonts, frames and scripts can all come from anywhere.
applicability: Deployments that render a default-src directive that names a wildcard source into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: Every fetch type without its own directive inherits the wildcard, so fonts, frames and scripts can all come from anywhere.
